title: 1701 Prairie's stone basement and its looped iron fence
items: The Hibbard house at 1701 Prairie now stands on a light stone basement up to the principal floor, across the front, round the south side and under the lower south wing, with brick only above it, as its old photograph shows.
Its street fence is now cast iron in rows of interlaced loops on a stone curb, in place of a plain spear fence.
